findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: request_action, contact_human, check_inquiry, list_messages · Private data: register_mailbox, request_action, get_request, contact_human · Public sink: express_interest, get_prices, request_action, request_invoice, contact_human, send_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: request_action, contact_human, check_inquiry, list_messages · Private data: register_mailbox, request_action, get_request, contact_human · Public sink: express_interest, get_prices, request_action, request_invoice, contact_human, send_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
